label: Increased Security - No Delivery
applies_when: A customer such as a business or government office has security measures preventing delivery.
scope_notes: Package is not delivered and is returned to station.

label: Incorrect Recipient Address
applies_when: The label address is incorrect, such as the recipient not residing there or the address being invalid.

label: Unable to Locate - Recipient Address
applies_when: The recipient address on the label or manifest cannot physically be located.

label: Non-residential Recipient Not In
applies_when: A business recipient is not in and driver release is not permitted because of signature requirements, driver judgment, or no OP-201 on file.
scope_notes: Business/non-residential condition.

label: Package Refused by Recipient
applies_when: The recipient refuses to accept the package at delivery.
scope_notes: Call-tag refusal also has a separate physical documentation sequence.

label: Residential Recipient Not In, Unable to Indirect/Driver Release
applies_when: Residential delivery is attempted but cannot be released or delivered, including recipient not in, gated community, no secure release location, or no eligible adult with ID for ASR.
scope_notes: Residential condition.

label: Delivery to a Business
applies_when: A Home Delivery package is delivered to a business.
scope_notes: Auto-applied when using FORGE.

label: Inspection Required
applies_when: A package has possible damage and is being returned to station for inspection.
scope_notes: Numeric collision: pickup reason code 10 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Non-residential Recipient Closed on Weekend
applies_when: A business location is closed on the weekend.
scope_notes: Cannot be used for residential recipients.
Numeric collision: pickup reason code 11 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Package Sorted to Wrong Route
applies_when: A package is found on the van after dispatch but should have been loaded to a different van.
scope_notes: Misload discovered after dispatch.

label: Residential Delivery with Signature
applies_when: A package is delivered to a residence and a signature is obtained.
scope_notes: Auto-applied when using FORGE.

label: Residence Driver Release
applies_when: A residential package is delivered without a signature and the release location is selected in FORGE.

label: Holding Package
applies_when: The recipient asks that the package be held at station for recipient pickup.
scope_notes: Numeric collision: pickup reason code 15 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Package on Manifest, Not on Van
applies_when: The package is on the FORGE or paper manifest but is not physically on the van.

label: Misdelivered Package Picked Up
applies_when: A package originally delivered to the wrong address is recovered.
scope_notes: Numeric collision: pickup reason code 17 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Misdelivered Package Delivered to Correct Recipient
applies_when: A previously misdelivered package is delivered to the correct address/recipient.

label: Indirect Delivery
applies_when: A package is delivered to an alternate location or address because the recipient is not in and there is no safe release location.
scope_notes: Examples include neighbor, front desk, or rental office.
Auto-applied in FORGE.
Not an option for ASR, DSR, or Appointment packages.

label: Business Driver Release
applies_when: A commercial recipient has a signed OP-201 on file authorizing release of non-signature-required packages.
scope_notes: Subject to unresolved conflict KNO-DEL-BUS-OP201-001 when no OP-201 exists.
Numeric collision: pickup reason code 21 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Call Tag Not Ready
applies_when: The call-tag package is not ready when pickup is attempted.
scope_notes: Applied to the call-tag label; separate signature and notation requirements apply.

label: Tendered to U.S. Postal Service
applies_when: The package is given to USPS for final delivery.

label: Return-to-Shipper Package Delivered to Shipper
applies_when: A return-to-shipper package is delivered to the shipper.
scope_notes: Numeric collision: pickup reason code 26 is a separate PICKUP_REASON namespace.

label: Package Not Delivered - No Attempt
applies_when: The package is loaded on the van but no delivery attempt is made.

label: Tendered to Interline Carrier
applies_when: The package is given to an established interline carrier for final delivery.

label: Call Tag Package Pickup
applies_when: A call-tag package is picked up and the call-tag label is securely placed on the package.

label: Inventory/Request Future Delivery
applies_when: A package cannot be delivered because the recipient is closed for inventory, a new-store opening, or a similar scenario.

label: Enroute Package Transfer
applies_when: A package is transferred to another route during the day after dispatch.

label: Contractor Refused Package
applies_when: A call-tag pickup is refused because of service restrictions such as hazmat, leaking package, or insufficient packaging.
scope_notes: Call-tag-specific acceptance refusal.

label: Local Weather Delay
applies_when: A delivery attempt cannot be made because of an approved weather event such as flooding or snow.
scope_notes: Requires an approved weather event.

label: Delivery Restriction/Local Holiday
applies_when: Delivery cannot be attempted because of an approved delivery restriction or local holiday.
scope_notes: Examples include Mardi Gras or conventions.

label: Transfer Custodial Control
applies_when: Packages are transferred to a hold location such as FedEx Office, Walgreens, or Dollar General.
scope_notes: Automatically applied when packages are scanned at delivery.

label: Customer Request - No Attempt Made
applies_when: CXPC sends an on-road intercept indicating that delivery should not be attempted.
scope_notes: FORGE automatically applies the code.
Write code 100 on the package.

label: Unable to Hold at Location
applies_when: The package cannot be held at the designated hold location.

label: Tendered to Canada Post
applies_when: The package is tendered to Canada Post for final delivery to the recipient.
scope_notes: Not for packages with PO Box or Rural Route delivery addresses.

label: PO Box or Rural Route Canada Post
applies_when: The package is tendered to Canada Post for final delivery to a PO Box or Rural Route.
scope_notes: Canada-specific.

label: Air Restricted Interline
applies_when: A package is transferred to USPS in Alaska because its contents are air restricted.
scope_notes: Alaska-specific.

label: Future Delivery Requested at Pickup
applies_when: At pickup, the shipper requests that the package not be delivered before a specified future date.
scope_notes: Future date is captured at pickup.

label: Package Received After Cutoff
applies_when: A package is picked up after the ramp cutoff time.

label: International Paperwork Incomplete
applies_when: An international package is picked up with incomplete paperwork and will require station intervention.
scope_notes: Station intervention required.

label: Country/City Not Served
applies_when: A package is not picked up because FedEx does not serve the destination, temporarily or permanently.

label: Exceeds Service Limits
applies_when: A package is not picked up because it exceeds a service limit such as weight or dimensions.

label: Incorrect Pickup Information
applies_when: Dispatch has incorrect contact, request, or package-location information and the courier cannot locate the packages.

label: Attempted Pickup Left Behind
applies_when: A package is left behind because it fails acceptance standards such as leaking/damage, missing or improper paperwork, or unacceptable payment method.

label: Payment Received for Duties and Taxes
applies_when: Payment is collected for duties and taxes while on road.
scope_notes: Available via FORGE only to Canada Express users.

label: Express On-Road Reroute
applies_when: An on-road automatic Redirect to Hold is performed.
scope_notes: This is not the transfer scan.
Available via FORGE only to Canada Express users.

label: Unable to Collect Payment for Duties and Taxes
applies_when: Payment for duties and taxes cannot be collected while on road.
scope_notes: Available via FORGE only to Canada Express users.

label: Package Retrieval
applies_when: Packages are picked up after expiring at a Hold location or a misdelivered package is retrieved after the same day.

label: Pickup Payment Received
applies_when: Express packages are picked up and payment is received at pickup.
scope_notes: OP-117 states that this is available in FORGE but not in Canada or the U.S.; preserve that wording pending scope clarification.

label: Regulatory Agency Delay
applies_when: A package receives a Clearance or Broker Select Option intercept while on road.
scope_notes: Auto-applied.

label: Security Delay - Waiting
applies_when: A customer security protocol delays delivery but still allows an attempt, such as inspection, escort, vehicle check, x-ray, or security-dog screening.
scope_notes: Express-only operational code.
Informational only when used on Ground packages.

label: Retail Refusal/O.S.A.
applies_when: The supplied 2024 OP-119 list labels code 030 as Retail Refusal/O.S.A.; the reviewed corpus does not define the operative criteria or expand O.S.A.
scope_notes: Code 030 is absent from the reviewed 2025-12-15 OP-117 status-code list.
Do not infer that an ordinary recipient refusal qualifies; ordinary package refusal is code 006 under current OP-117.
